craft_notes: Sthāyin: pedagogy-joy (mother's sweet). Sanskrit: balavibhīṣikāḥ + mātṛmodakavat + pravṛttyartham → L4 keeps terrors AND sweet across break. Rows: row 3 (for-going purpose). Close: on (going on — the point). Rejected: 'scary' — killed: strong kept (bala); 'lullaby' — killed: sweet kept (modaka = sweetmeat).

lines: For unawakened minds these are strong terrors;
like mother's sweet — all for the sake of going on.
l4.sanskrit_cite: aprabuddhamatīnāṃ hi etā balavibhīṣikāḥ | mātṛmodakavat sarvaṃ pravṛttyarthaṃ udāhṛtam

reads_against.argmap: Why such terrors for the unawakened? → The terrors are lures — mother's sweet leading the proceeding mind.
c1_essence: Terrors of unawakened minds: mother's sweet for going on.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder of the unspeakable)
